# EPUB 3 Samples Corpus

These unchanged EPUB binaries are test publications from the
[EPUB 3 Samples Project](https://github.com/IDPF/epub3-samples), release
[`20230704`](https://github.com/IDPF/epub3-samples/releases/tag/20230704),
commit `46d7e07e1b39b2d0a0245ececaf896edcd9de4b2`.

The project sample table identifies these publications as licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).
The license text is included as `CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt`. These separately licensed
test publications are not covered by epub-navigator's Apache-2.0 OR MIT source
license.

`moby-dick-excerpt.ogg` is derived from `moby-dick-mo.epub` under the same license: the
first 40 seconds of `OPS/audio/mobydick_001_002_melville.mp4`, transcoded to Ogg Opus by
the Elephant Ladder native host as described in `moby-dick-media-overlays/README.md`.

The SHA-256 digests and targeted test scenarios are recorded in `catalog.ts`.
The upstream project and the authors and contributors identified inside each
publication are attributed for their respective work.
